# Medical If someone finds themselves injured, Medical is tasked with bringing them to health. Since death is irreversible it can be helpful to have a basic understanding of medicine even not as a doctor.
Many wounds can be seen simply by [color=cyan]examined[/color] with [color=yellow][bold][keybind="ExamineEntity"][/bold][/color], which can help with basic first aid.
## The Body
For many injuries, taking a visit to [color=#5b97bc]Medical[/color] can help as you get used to everything. However, for the complete picture you can read about hwo bodies work, and it will help tremendously if you have the time.
The most important thing to know is that as long as someone's brain is alive they theoretically can be saved, [color=#00d3b8]but once a brain dies, it is dead, and the body cannot be rescuitated.[/color]
[textlink="Learn more about The Body." link="OffbrandBody"]
## Topicals
Topicals are the first step in treating brute or burn injuries, and different medicated bandages and salves may be better for specific types of wounds.
They serve as one of the most available healing methods, but can struggle with larger wounds.
[textlink="Learn more about Topicals." link="OffbrandTopicals"]
## Medications
Medications can be given to aid the body in healing passively, as well as giving pain relief.
[textlink="Learn more about Medications." link="OffbrandMedication"]
## Cryostasis
In emergency situations, you may not be able to attend to every patient in a timely manner.
Cryostasis devices allow you to slow down your patients' bodies, buying you more time.
[textlink="Learn more about Cryostasis." link="OffbrandCryostasis"]
## Surgery
Some injuries may be internal and surface-level administration of topicals or medicine will be unable heal. invisible to your eye but reported by the health analyzer.
Ensure patients are stable and wounds have been treated before bringing them to an operating room.
[textlink="Learn more about Surgery." link="OffbrandSurgery"]
